RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday, the August 25, 2006/Bhadrapada  3, 1928 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Agriculture; Agro and Rural Industries; Chemicals and Fertilizers;
Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution; Environment and Forests;
Health and Family Welfare; Railways; Small Scale Industries; Steel)
Total number of questions —20
Assurances/programmes for food and
nutrition security in N.C.M.P.
*421. SHRI  PRAVEEN RASHTRAPAL:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) the details of various assurances
given under the food and nutrition security
in the National Common Minimum
Programme (N.C.M.P.) of the Central
Government; and
(b) the actions taken to implement those
assurances/programmes?
Trains converted as superfast
†* 422. SHRI RUDRA NARAYAN
PANY: Will the Minister of RAILWAYS
be pleased to state:
(a) the number of trains converted as
superfast during this financial year;
(b) whether there was any need to
convert all these trains as superfast; and
(c) what prompted Government to
make this type of conversion in the mid of
the financial year?
Over-bridges in Bihar
*423. SHRI TARIQ ANWAR: Will the
Minister of RAILWAYS be pleased to
state:
(a) the details of the railway over-bridges
which were constructed or repaired in Bihar
during the last three years;
(b) whether it is a fact that the condition
of some major railway over-bridges is fast
deteriorating;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) what are the firm steps Government
are taking in this regard?
Traffic congestion due to railway
over-bridge at Rangapara
*424. SHRI SILVIUS CONDPAN: Will
the Minister of RAILWAYS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the railway over-bridge
being constructed at Rangapara in Sonitpur
District, Assam over the railway track of
Rangpara North (RPAN) to Markongseleek,
is causing heavy traffic congestion due to
frequent daily rail shunting and movement;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the action taken in this regard?
Clinical trials of Neseritide
*425. SHRI P. R. RAJAN: Will the
Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether permission has been granted
during the last two years, by the Drug
Controller General of India to conduct
clinical trials on a drug called Neseritide
(Natrecor), manufactured by Johnson and
Johnson, USA;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the Drug Controller General
of India sought certain clarifications and
expressed reservations for granting
permission for clinical trials to another
agency which applied for clinical trial of
same drug;
(d) if so, whether above clarifications
were resolved before granting permission
for doing clinical trials; and
(e) whether Government are aware that
South Africa denied clinical trials of the
above drug?
Environmental clearance to
Dholera Port
*426. SHRI SURYAKANTBHAI
ACHARYA:
SHRI KANJIBHAI PATEL:
Will the Minister of ENVIRONMENT
AND FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a proposal
for environmental clearance in respect of
Dholera Port has been received by the
Central Government from the State
Government of Gujarat;
(b) if so, the date on which it was
received;
(c) whether the clearance is still pending;
(d) if so, the reasons for such a long
period of pendency; and
(e) the time likely to be taken by
Government for according approval?
Authority for testing sources of soft
drinks
*427. SHRI T. T. V. DHINAKARAN:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
allegations of presence of pesticides in soft
drinks;
(b) whether Government would
constitute a separate authority to test
samples of the source of bottling of soft
drinks; and
(c) the steps taken to ensure safety in
this regard?
Ganga Action Plan
*428. SHRIMATI HEMA MALINI:
Will the Minister of ENVIRONMENT
AND FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) to what extent it is a fact that
ambitious Ganga Action Plan was envisaged
in 1985 with the financial allocation of
Rs. 1000 crores for the most sacred river of
the country and its tributaries;
(b) if so, whether it is also not a fact
that the water of the river is now even more
polluted than when the Plan was conceived
in 1985; and
(c) if so, what is the reaction of the
Central Government towards Ganga basin
States responsible for such dismal condition
of river Ganga?

Government for declaring the National

(c) whether this formula has been
opposed by the Council of Scientific and
Industrial Research as well as Planning

RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday, the August 25, 2006/Bhadrapada  3, 1928 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Agriculture; Agro and Rural Industries; Chemicals and Fertilizers;
Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution; Environment and Forests;
Health and Family Welfare; Railways; Small Scale Industries; Steel)
Total number of questions — 155
Assistance to A.P.
3034. SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have sent a
detailed communication to the Government
of Andhra Pradesh listing out the
developmental and welfare activities to be
taken up to prevent suicides;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government have also
announced Rs. 15,000 crores special
package for farmers in Andhra Pradesh;
(d) if so, the details thereof;
(e) whether Government have released
any amount, so far; and
(f) if so, the details thereof and how the
amount would be utilized by the State
Government?
Coverage of Bt. cotton
3035. SHRI VARINDER SINGH
BAJWA: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) the names of the States where Bt.
cotton was grown during 2005-06 and per
hectare net profit earned by the growers
from it;
(b) whether the area under Bt. cotton
has increased recently; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Speeding of research services
3036. SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) the status of research services for
farmers in the country;
(b) whether Government have
undertaken any steps to speed up research
services; and
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Plantation of jatropha
3037. SHRIMATI SYEDA ANWARA
TAIMUR:
SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that several private

701
players have launched serious pilot projects
for plantation of jatropha but at
Government level there is still no sign of a
comprehensive policy initiative to examine
the techno-economic viability and
feasibility of large scale production of feed
stock based on jatropha;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the action Government propose to
take in this regard?
Committee for welfare
of farmers
3038. SHRI N.R. GOVINDARAJAR:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to set
up a Committee to look into the problems
of farmers in the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the details of issues to be considered
by the said Committee?
Revising support price for agricultural
produces
3039. SHRI JANARDHANA
POOJARY: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the agriculture
sector in the country is passing through an
acute phase;
(b) if so, the details in this regard;
(c) whether with a view to providing
relief to the farmers, the Central
Government propose to revise the support
price for the agricultural produce; and
(d) if so, the details in this regard?
Setting up of IFZs
3040. SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether to give a clear thrust to farm
sector reforms, Government are considering
to set up Integrated Food Zones (IFZs);
(b) if so, whether Government have
identified 20 zones with the highest
potential across the country based on
availability of raw material, approach from
national highways, major rail links and
availability of infrastructure like water,
power and skilled manpower;
(c) whether IFZ scheme would address
the loopholes of existing schemes and
provide a holistic vision to overcome
industry constraints; and
(d) if so, by what time a final decision
in this regard is likely to be taken?
Development of rainfed
areas
3041. SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that at present,
there are numerous projects and schemes
which are being run for the development of
the rainfed areas;
(b) if so, the details of such projects
and schemes, State-wise;
(c) the budgetary outlay of these
projects and schemes for the current year;
and
(d) the utilization of such outlay, so
far?

702
Coconut plantations in Tamil Nadu
3042. SHRI S.P.M. SYED KHAN: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that vast areas of
coconut plantations in Tamil Nadu were
affected  due to various reasons;
(b) whether it is also a fact that the
areas of coconut plantations in the State
have shrunk due to low returns;
(c) the areas covered under coconut
plantations in the State during the last five
years; and
(d) the steps taken by Government to
boost coconut growing in the country?
Availability of agricultural land
3043. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is  a fact that availability
of agricultural land has shrunk due to
construction of houses and buildings over
